title: Open complaint on file -- commercial action suppressed even when the customer asks

utterances.text: Thanks for calling, this is Priya -- how can I help today?
I still have an open complaint, case C-2001, and nobody's called me back.
I'm sorry about that -- let me escalate this properly right now.
Okay. Also, do you have any better credit card offers? I saw an ad.
I'd rather make sure your complaint is resolved first before we talk about anything else.
